other_conditions: Must be enrolled in classes 8 to 12 in government‑aided or recognized schools
Must be a resident of West Bengal and studying in schools or colleges in the state
Must belong to a socio‑economically disadvantaged family (annual family income up to Rs. 1.2 lakh)
benefits_summary: Eligible girls receive an annual scholarship of Rs. 750 and unmarried girls aged 18 receive a one‑time grant of Rs. 25,000.
